column6: The Coricancha, the temple of the Sun, stood here, and ceques ran out from it to the valley's huacas.
Many Inca origin stories have the Creator make humanity, and later the sun, moon and stars, at this lake.
The viceroy kept the mummies of the Inca kings in the Hospital of San Andrés for around 80 years.

column3: Inca religion grows from older Andean traditions as a polytheist system of beliefs and rites, with many origin stories that begin at Lake Titicaca.
The state religion is administered from Cusco, where a calendar sets the festivals; the cult of the Sun is official while conquered peoples keep their own deities.
Polo de Ondegardo, Corregidor of Cuzco, hunts down the royal mummies and sends them to the viceroy in Lima.
